name: Pestilence
overview: Scripture reveals pestilence as a serious judgment from God, often sent to discipline His people or to bring about the fulfillment of His covenant promises. It was used to punish disobedience, as seen when pestilence was threatened against the Egyptians and the Israelites for their rebellion (Exodus 9:15; Numbers 14:12). The Lord's sovereign hand brings pestilence alongside other calamities, such as sword and terror, to correct and humble His people (Leviticus 26:16, 25). Yet, those who dwell securely in God’s presence are promised protection under His mighty shadow (Psalms 91:1).
